hed: The Small Cluster Nebula in Cepheus: A Compact Star-Forming Region
dek: An overview of the enigmatic nebula nestled within the constellation Cepheus, highlighting its characteristics and significance.
body:
The Small Cluster Nebula located in the constellation Cepheus represents an intriguing feature within the vast tapestry of our night sky. Situated approximately at right ascension 21.7167 hours and declination +66.1167 degrees, this celestial object is classified as a reflection nebula, a type known for its ability to highlight regions where interstellar dust reflects the light of nearby stars. Its compact nature suggests it is a dense cloud of gas and dust, potentially serving as a nurturing ground for new stars.
